name: Baroque tower
_about: A BAROQUE TOWER of stacked stages, each narrower than the one below: a square SHAFT `W` wide and `H` tall with a door at its foot (face 0, +z) and a window in each face of its upper tiers, a cornice round its head; the BELFRY, stepped in by `s`, a great open arch in each face over a parapet -- the viewing level; its cornice and ceiling; a smaller UPPER STAGE on a chamfered square with a round window in each main face, its cornice; a bulbous CAP of any profile (onion by default) and a LANTERN standing on it where it has narrowed to the lantern's width (`domed-tower`, with its own little cap and finial). Build "stair" by name to climb it: a `tower-stair` in the shaft (its turret in the corner `stairYaw` turns it to, the far corner from the door by default) up to the belfry's floor at H; or "belfry floor" for a tower that is not climbed. Place it at the shaft's middle. El Pilar's four corner towers.

params._W: the shaft: W wide outside, walls t thick, H tall -- the floor the stair arrives at, the belfry's; lowH its blind lower tier (the door on face 0 in it), two tiers of windows (winW wide) above
params._s: the belfry steps in by s all round with walls s thinner, so its inside is the shaft's: BH tall, an arch archW wide in each face over a parapet archSill high, open (the viewing level)
params._W3: the upper stage: a chamfered square W3 across, walls t3, H3 tall, a round window ocR in radius in each main face
params._profile: the cap's section (onion + bulge/neck, bell + waist/lift, pointed + spread, segmental + rise), capR its radius
params._lanternR: the lantern on the cap: it stands where the cap has narrowed to lanternR
params._stairYaw: turns the stair's turret to a corner of the shaft (pi: the far one from the door); tR its radius

shaft._about: the square shaft: blind below with the door in face 0, a window in each face of the two tiers above

stair._about: the stair up the shaft to the belfry's floor (build it by name): a turret in a corner, the floor round its head

belfry floor._about: the belfry's floor where the tower is not climbed (build it by name instead of the stair): the bells' floor, not walked

cornice._about: the cornice round the shaft's head, its inside buried in the shaft's walls

belfry._about: the belfry: stepped in outside, its inside the shaft's (clear of a stair turret's head), a great open arch in every face over a parapet

belfry head._about: the belfry's ceiling and cornice, what the upper stage stands on

upper stage._about: the upper stage, a chamfered square, a round window in each main face

upper head._about: its cornice and ceiling, what the cap stands on

cap._about: the bulbous cap -- glazed tiles at El Pilar

lantern._about: the lantern on the cap, its own little onion and the finial
